name: Spec-Driven Development
description: Preserves intent through specification, plan, tasks, implementation and cross-artifact verification.
constraints: Specifications must reflect user intent and known constraints; do not invent requirements.
Keep artifacts proportional to the work instead of generating ceremonial documentation.
When implementation conflicts with the approved specification, expose the conflict before changing intent.
guidance: Write a concise specification containing outcome, users, scope, constraints and observable acceptance criteria.
Translate the specification into an implementation plan and tasks with explicit dependencies.
Carry stable identifiers for requirements and checks across the artifacts.
Implement from the current task while retaining prior verified artifacts as context.
Run a final consistency review across specification, plan, tasks, code and tests.
completion_checks: Every implemented behavior maps to an in-scope requirement or documented repair.
Every acceptance criterion has evidence or an explicit unresolved status.
Specification, plan and implementation contain no known contradiction.
The artifact set is concise enough to reuse as continuation context.
